hypotheses.mechanism: The payment-svc db pool configuration was changed to a lower acquire timeout, causing frequent timeouts and 503 errors when the pool is busy.

cause.statement: The payment-svc db pool acquire timeout was reduced from 3000ms to 1000ms in deployment d-576.

runtime_effect.statement: The db pool acquire timeout is now 1000ms, leading to frequent timeouts when the pool is busy.

symptom.statement: Checkout-svc receives 503 errors from payment-svc due to db pool timeouts.

runtime_effect.statement: The high number of upstream calls to payment-svc is causing increased latency and errors.
